close_reason: Changed TrustAnchor::TryFrom<Certificate>::Error from raw der::Error to opaque DerError newtype.
description:
Pass 1 P3 commit ff707564 (PKIX-h98q) intentionally wrapped `pkix_path::Error::Der(der::Error)` in an opaque `DerError` newtype to insulate downstream from `der::Error`'s instability. However, the migration is incomplete: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:505 still exposes raw `der::Error` in TrustAnchor's TryFrom impl:

    impl TryFrom<Certificate> for TrustAnchor {
        type Error = der::Error;   // <-- LEAKS raw der::Error
        ...
    }

This means downstream callers using `TrustAnchor::try_from(cert)` see the unstable `der::Error` type in their public API surface (whether they want to or not — the From-conversions and matches!() patterns force it). When the `der` crate bumps to 0.8 (or any breaking version), every user of TrustAnchor::try_from breaks even if the rest of pkix-path's API stays compatible.

The brief flagged this kind of API change as intentional, but only for Error variant payloads. The TryFrom Error associated type is a separate exposure point that wasn't covered.

Fix options (one of):

A. Wrap in DerError: `type Error = DerError;` and propagate via `.map_err(DerError)?` in try_from.

B. Define a dedicated TrustAnchor error variant (TrustAnchorError, NameConstraintsParse, etc.) and use it.

Recommend option A — minimal change, keeps the public API surface in one opaque newtype, matches the rest of the migration intent.

Cross-reference docstring at line 505: 'Returns Err(der::Error)' — also stale; should match whichever wrapper is chosen.
title: P2: TrustAnchor::TryFrom<Certificate>::Error leaks raw der::Error — opaque-wrapper migration (PKIX-h98q) is incomplete
